instructions.question: Does this Facebook comment on a Kosovo public-health COVID-19 post express a clearly positive feeling, a clearly negative (hostile or alarmed) feeling, or neither?
instructions.rule: Neutral is the default: jokes, banter, betting on numbers, ironic cheering for more cases, tagging friends, questions, opinions, suggestions, demands for measures, mild doubts, political jabs and long lectures are neutral even when critical or sarcastic. Negative needs a clearly hostile or distressed tone: insults, swearing, 'shame on you' aimed at the institute, explicit accusations of lying, or despair about rising deaths and cases. Positive covers praise, thanks, prayers, 'amen' and relief or hope about falling numbers, including phrases like 'sosht keq' (not bad).

neutral.what: Everything without a clear strong feeling: name tags, banter, betting or league jokes about numbers, questions, statistics, suggestions, calls for measures, political remarks, mild criticism of the posts or the numbers.
examples: Prap Prishtina spe lshon kreun e tabeles (Again Prishtina won't give up the top of the table)
Hajde ma gjallë (Come on, more lively)
Albin Kurti i ka fajet.. (Albin Kurti is to blame..)
Numri i te testuarve eshte i vogel! (The number tested is small!)
neutral.cues: haha; bast/bastore (bet); lige/tabele (league/table); hajde; tagged names; a ka (is there); qysh (how); pse (why); duhet (should); mbyllni/hapni (close/open); fajet (blame) in a passing remark
neutral.not_for: Insults, swearing, 'turp të kini' or explicit 'you are lying' aimed at the institute are negative; relief at low numbers is positive.

positive.what: Praise or thanks to health workers, prayers and blessings, and relief or hope that cases are low or falling.
examples: Ju lumte per punen suksese! (Well done for the work, success!)
So keq sa per fillim (Not bad for a start)
Kur don zoti per bajram dalum 0-0 (God willing, by Bayram we come out 0-0)
Lutem te jen te fundit ! (I pray they are the last!)
positive.cues: bravo; ju lumte (well done); faleminderit (thank you); respekt; amin (amen); zoti na rujt (God protect us); t'hajrit kofshin (may it be for good); inshallah (God willing); sosht keq (it's not bad); lutem (I pray); sherim (recovery)
positive.not_for: Greetings or jokes to a tagged friend ('Veton F. Mahmuti aje mirë!', 'Granit I. Rudi mbajuni') and ironic 'Hajde ma gjall' (come on, more) are neutral; thanks followed by a long complaint is neutral.

negative.what: Clearly hostile or distressed comments: insults, swearing, explicit accusations that the institute lies, angry shaming, fear or despair about the growing toll.
examples: Mos rreni ma shum (Stop lying more)
Turp të kini (Shame on you)
16 të vdekur dhe 258 të infektuar për 24 orë. Kah po shkojmë kështu (16 dead and 258 infected in 24 hours. Where are we heading like this)
Ta bajn mut na per dy dit mena dhan liri (Damn them, they gave us freedom for two days)
negative.cues: rreni/rrejt (lying); mashtrus (fraud); turp të kini (shame on you); mut (shit); nanen, qifsha (swearing); kah po shkojmë (where are we heading); katastrofë (catastrophe)
negative.not_for: Joking doubts about numbers, sarcastic banter, political jabs, demands to close or open things, and long critical advice are neutral.
